reference.title: Manage API keys
reference.shortdesc: The Manage API Keys page in Admin profile allows administrators to:

section.p: The Manage API Keys page in Admin profile allows administrators to:

ul.li: access API and IoT endpoints for your subscription

section.p: For more information on REST API, see the ADI OtoSense™ REST API Guide.
For more information about OAuth 2.0 bearer token authentication, see RFC 6750: The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework: Bearer Token Usage.

ol.li: Log in to the SMS web application.

li.p: On the top right of the user interface, click the placeholder arrow next to your name and click API.
The Manage API Keys page is displayed with a list of existing API keys.
In the Create New Key window, enter the name of the API key, its role, and its description in their respective fields.
A new key is created and listed in the manage API Keys page.

ol.li: Log in to the SMS web application.

li.p: On the top right of the user interface, click the placeholder arrow next to your name and click API.
The Manage API Keys page is displayed with a list of existing API keys.

ol.li: Find the API key that you want to edit or delete.
To edit an API key, click Edit.
In the Edit Key window, change the name, role or description as required and click SAVE.
To delete an API key, click Delete.

li.p: In the Delete API Key window, click DELETE.
To access API and IoT endpoints:

ol.li: Log in to the SMS web application.

li.p: On the top right of the user interface, click the placeholder arrow next to your name and click API.
The Manage API Keys page is displayed with a list of existing API keys.
The Endpoints page with the API and IoT endpoints are displayed.

ol.li: Click Copy next to the respective endpoint link.
